The 2025–26 season was the 133rd season in the history of Newcastle United Football Club, and their ninth consecutive season in the Premier League. In addition to the domestic league, the club also participated in the FA Cup, the EFL Cup and the UEFA Champions League.

Pre-season and friendlies

[edit]

As part of pre-season, Newcastle United announced they would head to Scotland to face Scottish Premiership champions Celtic,[50] and to Singapore to face fellow Premier League side Arsenal as part of the Singapore's Festival of Football Tournament.[51] Also confirmed was a first-ever visit to South Korea, to take part in the prestigious Coupang Play Series 2025, against K League XI and Tottenham Hotspur.[52] On 2 June, it was announced that St James' Park would host the 2025 Sela Cup against Atlético Madrid.[53] A second home friendly was later confirmed, against Espanyol.[54]

FA Cup

[edit]
Main article: 2025–26 FA Cup

As a Premier League club, Newcastle entered the FA Cup in the third round, and were drawn at home to Bournemouth.[70] They were then drawn away to Aston Villa in the fourth round,[71][72] and at home to Manchester City in the fifth round.[73][74]

EFL Cup

[edit]
Main article: 2025–26 EFL Cup

As a Premier League club involved in European competition, Newcastle entered the EFL Cup in the third round, and were drawn at home to Bradford City.[75][76] They were then drawn at home to Tottenham Hotspur in the fourth round,[77][78] and at home to Fulham in the quarter-finals.[79][80] A two-legged tie against Manchester City was drawn for the semi-finals, with the first leg at home and second leg away.[81][82]
